articles.title: Russia deploys hypersonic Oreshnik missiles in Belarus amid Europe tensions
articles.summary: Russia has released footage showcasing the deployment of its Oreshnik hypersonic missile system in Belarus. This strategic move significantly bolsters Moscow's capability to target European territories, escalating geopolitical tensions. For SSB aspirants, understanding such advanced military deployments and their implications is crucial for comprehending regional power dynamics and potential future security challenges in Europe.

articles.title: India’s markets clock tenth straight gain in 2025 even as smallcaps underperformed: HDFC AMC's Navneet Munot
articles.summary: Navneet Munot, MD and CEO of HDFC AMC Ltd, observed Indian markets demonstrated resilience entering 2025, reflecting on their robust performance over the past year. In a year-end note, he highlighted the strong foundational aspects of the Indian economy. This resilience signifies a stable domestic economic environment, crucial for national growth and providing confidence in India's financial future for SSB aspirants to note.

articles.title: China launches largest military drills off Taiwan in 8 months with live-fire exercises caught on camera
articles.summary: China conducted its largest military encirclement of Taiwan in eight months, firing rockets into nearby waters during live-fire drills on Tuesday. These significant exercises were a direct warning to "separatist" forces, escalating regional tensions. Aspirants should note the implications of such actions on Indo-Pacific security and international relations, particularly concerning maritime disputes and sovereignty.
